3894.title: Claude expiry recovery guidance and credential refresh
3894.rootCauseOneLine: Usage refresh rereads expired credentials without renewing them, while displayed guidance omits the explicit login action known to provider health. The actual chat failure after terminal startup remains unverified.
3894.proposedFix: Align recovery guidance with the explicit login action and execution host; first verify completed sign-in and credential-source selection before changing authentication behavior.
3894.caveats: Synthetic maintenance tests only. No real OAuth login or chat session. Keychain/file disagreement is a demonstrated conditional mechanism, not confirmed for this reporter. Full reproduction test and output excerpts are inline in the HTML; raw artifacts retained locally under reports publication policy.
